answer_set.note: the selection set is the scored questions not in this answer set (414 at Slice 40), counted from the data

rule.text: Slice 41 test-plan 4.1, fixed before the run, applied to the selection set only; it picks the harness policy, not the SDK defaults. 1. Keep the policies that pass REQ41-M2 on both arms (SSA allfull >= .89; every other type's allfull >= the mix control's minus .02). 2. Of those, adopt the one with the highest mean weighted allfull over the two arms; ties: the smaller k, then the larger compact_chars. 3. Adopt only if its weighted allfull beats the control by at least .05 on both arms. 4. If none qualifies, M3 uses T3/A300 (the SDK default) and the result is reported to the owner.

mf1.source: REQ41 5.4: on the recorded FTS top-100 at engine 5b09afd44 (sweep100_fts.jsonl, key ids100), the 414-question selection set; (c)'s SSP .950 is the expected cost, not a defect
mf1.rules: (c) full_ids = the hits of the rank-1 hit's session past the first full_items, up to cap - full_items, so at most cap items render in full (variants.py promote); (b) full_items = 8 when the question matches the assistant-reference detector of variants.py. Both are harness heuristics (REQ41-F6).
